title: Pollen balances got clearer boundaries
summary:
This week made Pollen balances easier to understand while tightening model routing, image-worker registration, and the edges around failed requests.

Tier Pollen moved to daily balances that reset at 00:00 UTC without rollover. Requests use the tier balance before crypto and pack Pollen, and Enter now shows the breakdown more clearly. Separately, seven paid-only models were set to use purchased-pack or crypto Pollen rather than daily grants; the model API, Play, and Enter now identify them.

`kimi` now routes to Kimi K2.5, with image input, a 256,000-token context window, and new aliases. `nova-fast` and Claude 3.5 Haiku moved to native Bedrock routing through Portkey, with Nova Lite as a fallback for `nova-fast`. Failed image URLs in Claude and Gemini vision requests now return clearer client errors instead of generic 500s.

Configurable registration addresses were added for Flux, Z-Image, and Sana workers to help avoid network filtering that could prevent registration. Supporter-logo generation switched to Z-Image, and the retired `turbo` image model was removed from the registry and its dedicated routing.

Enter brought back a banner showing the three newest GitHub-hosted highlights. News and README updates covered recent model, SDK, and payment-option announcements; those copy changes were not themselves implementations. The catalog also added @its3li’s Moltbot, a Telegram and WhatsApp assistant built with Pollinations.
